mapper.select: select c.id,c.parent_id,c.name,c.description,c.cover,c.sort,c.is_published published,c.create_time,c.update_time, (select count(*) from blog_column_relation r join blog b on b.id=r.blog_id and b.is_deleted=0 where r.column_id=c.id) blog_count from blog_column c order by c.parent_id,c.sort,c.id

select c.id,c.parent_id,c.name,c.description,c.cover,c.sort,c.is_published published,c.create_time,c.update_time, (select count(distinct b.id) from blog_column_relation r join blog b on b.id=r.blog_id and b.is_published=true and b.is_deleted=0 where r.column_id=c.id) blog_count from blog_column c left join blog_column p on p.id=c.parent_id where c.is_published=true and (c.parent_id=0 or p.is_published=true) order by c.parent_id,c.sort,c.id
select id,parent_id,name,description,cover,sort,is_published published,create_time,update_time from blog_column where id=#{id}
select count(*) from blog_column where parent_id=#{parentId}
select count(*) from blog_column where parent_id=#{parentId} and name=#{name} and (#{excludeId} is null or id != #{excludeId})
select id,parent_id,name,description,cover,sort,is_published published,create_time,update_time from blog_column where parent_id=#{parentId} and name=#{name} limit 1
select id,parent_id,name,description,cover,sort,is_published published,create_time,update_time from blog_column where name=#{name} order by id limit 1
select coalesce(max(sort),0) from blog_column where parent_id=#{parentId}
mapper.update: update blog_column set cover=#{cover},update_time=now() where id=#{id}
